questions.implements: Does the diff implement what the repository records for the Jira issue, and add or change a test that checks it? Judge the code in the diff, not the answer.

judge.reason: The diff matches R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT and adds tests for it. VolumeDiscount gives 0 below 10 units and 5% of the line at 10 or more, using integer division so it rounds down to the cent. PlaceOrder adds up the discount line by line. PriceWithVolumeDiscount applies the discount code to the subtotal after the volume discount, then caps the combined discount at 50% of the original subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the cap. The tests cover the threshold and rounding (TestVolumeDiscount), the code applying after the volume discount and the combined cap (TestPriceWithVolumeDiscount), and checkout end to end with lines rounded separately (TestPlaceOrderVolumeDiscount).
